verdicts.reason: A and B are essentially identical, and both are unusable. The photo is an upscaled crop that is badly pixelated and blurry. The translucent panel is gone, so dark text sits straight on a busy cityscape. The text is scattered: 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' is stranded bottom-left and reads after 'London', which breaks the original reading order. The tagline floats off to the right. The chevrons are blown up into a heavy row that crowds the middle of the layout and pulls focus from the headline.
